title: The Enchanter's Licence
subtitle: One criterion of an advancement
description: The licence is granted on one criterion of the enchanting
beside it, `criterion: enchanted` -- one criterion of the
advancement instead of the whole thing.
The fee is paid in experience, which is its own kind of task: an
`xp` task is manual by design -- the press takes the points,
because experience is not something the engine should skim off
the moment you happen to be carrying enough. The ashen road's
home road pays xp back the same way.
The ashen road's blaze rod was the whole advancement; this is the
surgical version, for advancements whose criteria are worth
